evidence: Extensively updates util::Result in src/util/result.h and adds src/util/messages.{h,cpp}.
rationale: Expands the shared util::Result template with structured failure types and warning/error merging, providing a standardized error-handling pattern across the codebase. The author notes this resolves 'a key missing feature that makes the result class not useful for functions like LoadChainstate() which produce different errors that need to be handled differently', unblocking downstream work in wallet loading (#25722) and kernel fatal error reporting (#29700).
